## Summary

Integrates the ADR0155 managed llama.cpp backend and AI Studio setup flow on the current-main v3 branch. Adds WindowsNative/WSL2 execution identity, demand-driven loopback inference, explicit GGUF registration/copy approval, runtime setup/removal, resource lifecycle integration, benchmark provenance, and additive Ollama migration semantics.
